title: Sum of an Array
description:
Given n integers, print their sum.

Input format:
The first line contains n. The second line contains n space-separated integers.

Output format:
Print the sum.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Adding all four values gives 8.

title: Count Target Occurrences
description:
Given n integers and a target value, count how many times the target appears.

Input format:
The first line contains n. The second line contains n space-separated integers. The final line contains the target.

Output format:
Print the number of occurrences.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The value 2 appears three times.
The target 4 does not appear.

title: Binary Search
description:
Given a sorted array and a target, print the zero-based index of the target. Print -1 if it is not present. If the target appears more than once, any matching index is accepted.

Input format:
The first line contains n. The second line contains n sorted integers. The final line contains the target.

Output format:
Print the index or -1.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The target 7 is at index 3.
The target is not in the array.

title: Reverse an Array
description:
Given n integers, print them in reverse order.

Input format:
The first line contains n. The second line contains n space-separated integers.

Output format:
Print the reversed values separated by spaces.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The array values are printed from last to first.
The reversed order is 6, 0, -1, 8.

title: Next Greater Element
description:
For each value in an array, find the first value to its right that is greater than it. If no greater value exists to the right, use -1.

Input format:
The first line contains n. The second line contains n space-separated integers.

Output format:
Print the answers in order, separated by spaces.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Each element is paired with its next larger value to the right.
No element has a greater value to its right.

title: Fibonacci Number
description:
Given a non-negative integer n, print the nth Fibonacci number. The sequence starts with F(0) = 0 and F(1) = 1.

Input format:
A single integer n, where 0 <= n <= 92.

Output format:
Print F(n).

visibleTestCases.explanation: The sequence begins 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13.

title: Climbing Stairs
description:
You are climbing a staircase with n steps. Each time you can climb either 1 or 2 steps. Print the number of distinct ways to reach the top.

Input format:
A single integer n, where 0 <= n <= 90.

Output format:
Print the number of ways.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The ways are 1+1+1, 1+2, and 2+1.
There are eight ways to climb five steps.

title: Queue Command Processor
description:
Process q queue commands. Each command is either "enqueue x" to add x to the back, or "dequeue" to remove and print the front value. If the queue is empty during a dequeue, print EMPTY.

Input format:
The first line contains q. Each of the following q lines contains one command.

Output format:
Print one result for each dequeue command, each on its own line.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The first two dequeue commands return 4 and 8 in FIFO order.
The first dequeue finds an empty queue; the next returns 9.

title: Breadth-First Search Traversal
description:
Given an undirected graph with vertices numbered 1 through n and a starting vertex s, print the vertices in breadth-first search order. Visit neighbors in the order their edges appear in the input. The graph may be disconnected; print only vertices reachable from s.

Input format:
The first line contains n and m. The next m lines each contain an edge u v. The final line contains s.

Output format:
Print the traversal order separated by spaces.

visibleTestCases.explanation: BFS visits all immediate neighbors before moving to the next level.
Only vertices reachable from start vertex 3 are printed.

title: Number of Islands
description:
Given a grid containing only 0s and 1s, count the number of islands. An island is a group of adjacent 1s connected horizontally or vertically. Diagonal contact does not connect islands.

Input format:
The first line contains rows and columns. The next rows lines each contain a string of columns characters, each either 0 or 1.

Output format:
Print the number of islands.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The upper-left group and lower-right group are separate islands.
There are no cells containing 1.
